scenario.name: The link to the Twin drops and comes back
scenario.description: The Brain's connection to the Twin is cut for 15 s (fault injected on the Brain's side of the link), then restored.
scenario.trigger: python scenarios/run.py SY03   (or the Run button on the control center; --server to play it on the running Brain, live or mock)

expected.twin: Keeps running; unreachable for the Brain for 15 s.
expected.brain: Reports 'Twin unreachable' at once (status, timeline, red badge), keeps its state, resumes when the link is back. With fallback.auto_switch_to_mock it would switch to mock.
